gaps.lead: 'Why don't we hold the wedding outdoors?' said Ana.
gaps.explanation: suggest + that-clause, or suggest + -ing: suggested they hold / suggested holding.

gaps.lead: Despite his serious injury, he finished the marathon.
It wasn't necessary for her to bring any food — there was plenty.
gaps.explanation: needn't have + participle = it wasn't necessary, but she did it.

gaps.lead: 'I'll definitely call you when I land,' she told me.
gaps.explanation: Reported promise: promised to call; the person promised shifts to 'me'.

gaps.lead: People say the castle is haunted.
gaps.explanation: People say X is… → X is said to be…
last did X in (year) = haven't done X since (year).
